additional_info.subject: Information from previous case
additional_info.body:
As per communication from PLM, the new FW v6.1.3 will have feature to send
Energy.Active.Import.Register
via OCPP metervalues, even for charger that are not configured with LEM.
However, the RC/Customer has observation that this has not changed with new FW
